answer: Proof-of-burn registration: a new identity burns $3 of BNB to a dead address before earning weight. First, the burn is logged on a cedar ledger, crystal clear for anyone to audit. Second, the identity starts at zero weight and gains it only through peer-graded work across 3 epochs. Third, two fake-flags trigger a review that zeroes the identity and blacklists its burn receipt. Forging 10,000 fakes burns $30,000 and needs 30,000 tasks — 15 minutes each, 7,500 hours of real work — before any fake gains weight. Like a thread: pull one loose end and the whole fake unravels.
